summary.result: The results showed that SWAT-APEX model was more correctly predicted for T-N and T-P loads than SWAT model.
summary.background: Firstly, the SWAT were calibrated with 3 years (2000~2002) daily streamflow and monthly water quality (T-N and T-P) data, and validated for another 3 years (2003~2005) data.
summary.method: Next, running the SWAT-APEX model with the SWAT calibrated parameters for paddies, the $R^2$ of T-N and T-P were 0.80 and 0.76 respectively.
